# Ex-1

## Statistical Operations

```{r}
size <- c(158,181,178,166,175,181,162,185,190,167,181,177)

unique(size)[which.max(tabulate(match(size, unique(size))))] # package modeest not working on arch linux
mean(size)
median(size)
```

## Percentiles

```{r}
quantile(size)
quantile(size, probs = c(0.05, 0.2, 0.80, 0.95))
```

## Days

```{r}
library(tbrf)

days <- c(1000,1200,1300,1500,1600)

p <- ((gm_mean(days) / days[1]) - 1) * 100

rel_procentual_changes <- days[-1] / days[-length(days)]

average_change <- tbrf::gm_mean(rel_procentual_changes)

average_change
```

## Solar

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)

solar <- read.csv2("../../Data/Solar.csv")
head(solar)
solar$Datum <- as.Date(solar$Datum, "%d.%m.%Y")
solar$h <- c(NA, diff(solar$h))

head(solar)

ggplot(solar, aes(x=Datum, y=h, colour=h)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggtitle("Solar") +
  labs(y="Hours", x = "Date") +
  geom_line(aes(y = rollmean(h, 3, na.pad = TRUE, align = "right")), linewidth = 0.1, color="green") +
  geom_line(aes(y = rollmean(h, 10, na.pad = TRUE, align = "right")), linewidth = 0.1, color="red") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("solar_data.png", width = 10, height = 4)

```
